check_transformers_available: check if the transformers library is available in the current python environment
check_torchaudio_available: check if the torchaudio library is available in the current python environment
requires_backends_validate: validate that required backend libraries like scipy or accelerate are installed before use
create_dummyobject_metaclass: create a metaclass that raises ImportError when a missing backend dependency is accessed
review_backends_mapping: review the BACKENDS_MAPPING OrderedDict to see which optional backends are registered and their error messages
